title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for P_{2}^{1} as a function of pressure and temperature.

title: Partition Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive or state the Grand Canonical partition function for a single adsorption site.

title: Probability Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the probability P_{1}^{1} for one site being full.

title: Chemical Potential
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly express the chemical potential of the ideal gas and its relation to lambda.

title: Variable Definitions
description: Optional Criteria: The student should clearly define all variables used, such as lambda, x, and p_0.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the binding energy terms.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms in the final expression are dimensionally consistent.
